newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: EU finance ministers break for dinner, bilaterals.
newsitem.headline: EU finance ministers break for dinner, bilaterals.

text.p: European Union finance ministers have interrupted their negotiations on a budget pact to secure the stability of a single currency to have dinner and hold bilateral discussiosn, EU officials said on Thursday.
Two EU sources said that the ministers were now having dinner and would resume full talks at 2200 GMT.

But a third source said bilateral talks were also taking place. "The presidency will hold bilateral talks to see if there is agreement on exceptional and extraordinary circumstances," the source said.

The ministers are seeking to break deadlock over details of the stability pact to enforce fiscal discipline, particularly the definition of the 'exceptional and temporary' economic circumstances under which a country could overspend without incurring penalties.

Under the broad terms of the pact, countries which exceeded an agreed budget deficit level would normally face sanctions and then fines within the EU's planned monetary union, set to start on January 1, 1999.
